answer: Require every identity to present a hardware attestation from a distinct physical device, a TPM or secure-enclave signature proving a unique machine, plus an 80 POA stake locked 60 days. A ridge of hardware cost blocks cheap fakes: each extra identity needs another real device, roughly $80 in hardware plus a fresh stake, and a revoked attestation creates a ripple that freezes all rewards tied to that device. Devices earn a jade seal only after 30 days of verified work; auditors check signatures against manufacturer roots and slash 40% of the stake for forged or shared hardware.
